directAnswer.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. The materials cell names cement mortar, concrete and grout, still inside particle ≤8 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at 380 V, 11/15 kW, hydraulic control and all-copper dual motor, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m horizontal / 70 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, applicable materials cement mortar, concrete and grout, 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm and 650 kg. Do not move the same condition onto M9, which prints 380 V / 50 Hz, 30 L/min, 50 bar, 50 m horizontal / 20 m vertical, hose 25 mm, hopper 115 L, loading height 90 cm, particle ≤4 mm, 1230 × 720 × 1550 mm and 200 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
